_this_field_is_not_called_design_sha256_: a live design hash is a thing a chain binds to. This document binds nothing and must not be loadable as though it did.
_contract: The COST-ORDERED SPLIT DESIGN. It never produced a structural or behavioural datum: it was designed on 2026-10-01 and superseded on 2026-10-02, before any A-bsz3 session existed. Kept because a supersession that leaves no trace reads later as a design that never happened, and because most of its content was carried forward rather than discarded.

what_it_proposed.step_1: one same-device structural/runtime comparison, booked to the GPU engineering allowance
what_it_proposed.step_2: CONDITIONAL on the digests differing: at most three newly trained treatment probes against attempt75's controls, booked to the formal allowance
what_it_proposed.fail_fast: stop after seed 1 if the correctness delta was <= -0.030
what_it_proposed.gating: a differing artifact digest was the TRIGGER for step 2; identical digests ended the study

why_it_was_superseded.reason: the split required an intermediate approval between its two halves, and the programme wants the practical question answered ONCE. A3 now runs initialization, recovery, evaluation, aggregation and closeout as one chain.
two_specific_changes: a differing A-bsz3 artifact digest is no longer a gate. It is an experimental FINDING, recorded as a diagnostic, and the chain proceeds into recovery.

the -0.030 seed-1 fail-fast is withdrawn as a normal experimental stop. A3 trains all three seeds, because a point estimate at one seed is the instrument rather than the protocol -- which the derived noise band says directly.
why_it_was_superseded._the_split_was_not_wrong_about_cost: cost-ordering a conditional study is sound when the cheap half can end it. It stops being an advantage when the expensive half is wanted either way.

what_was_carried_forward: the whole diagnostic set -- digests, kept-head maps, per-head scores, rank correlation, score drift, selection margins, position counters, runtime with spread, peak VRAM -- now collected INSIDE the chain
the reuse of attempt75's three protocol-uniform A controls, unretrained
the protocol-identity requirements, now verified before the first scientific probe
the cross-session claim boundary, which remains explicit
the scientific-vs-materialization identity distinction and its forward obligation on D1/D2/D3
the derived seed-level noise band, now a reporting reference rather than a stop
the refusal to claim a population-level non-inferiority result
what_was_dropped: the two-session shape and its intermediate approval
the engineering-allowance booking for a first half -- A3 is one session on the formal book, because it trains probes and consumes the frozen confirmation battery
the three priced session shapes, replaced by one full-chain price
